Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.
He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’…
Yahweh, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!
But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.
